facts.fact: The IFC deal record says Raxio operates carrier-neutral colocation data centres in Tanzania, among seven countries; the facility is not named and the date is the document's published year 2025.

The IFC deal record says Raxio's carrier-neutral data centres in Tanzania, among six other countries, are Tier III (operator and IFC statement, no certifying body named); the facility is not named and the date is the document's published year 2025.
